segments.comment: Variation of orcish-town-stolen-booty: after the Orcish Town level teleport, a second ^V to depth 20 is clamped by get_level() to the bottom of the Gnomish Mines, where the gang leader arrives with MIGR_LEFTOVERS and dog.c mon_arrive() collects the remaining booty through deliver_obj_to_mon(0, DF_ALL).
